lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are arranged in a highly organized rectilinear grid consisting of at least 6 horizontal rows and approximately 12 vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, creating a lattice-like visual structure where blobs act as anchor nodes at the intersection of horizontal rows and vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin's silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6 to 8 high-luminance blobs, appearing less densely packed than the primary flank constellation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An elongated, yellowish-tan, curved structure is attached to the dorsal-posterior region of the flank, appearing as a distinct foreign body or biological attachment trailing behind the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a significantly higher spatial density of micro-blobs with a stochastic, non-grid distribution compared to the organized lateral flank patterning.
